effect.name: Color Grading Suite
effect.desc: Full single-pass grading toolset: white balance, exposure/contrast/highlights/shadows/whites/blacks, saturation, vibrance, clarity, dehaze, a 5-point master curve plus per-channel RGB curves, lift/gamma/gain, three-way color wheels, split toning, creative looks (faded film, sharpen, grain, bleach bypass, cross process), vignette, and master gamma/gain/offset.
